metrics.rim: cohkit.ink_gate_group at rimPx: visible ink width on every silhouette edge pixel at native 1080p, gate = rimFrac of them (+ the kit's dark / hull colour checks)
metrics.lit: median over the figure's solid toon pixels in the key light's light band (h = N.L * .5 + .5 >= T_LIGHT) or rim light (weight >= .5), marker and emissive pixels excluded, of |CIELAB L* - median L* of the ground field| >= litDeltaL (signedDeltaL: the region's median L* minus the ground's, a diagnostic)
metrics.marker: largest solid k x k block (coverage >= .5) of the visible family-marker swatches, the rest of the figure occluding, >= markerPx
metrics.diagnostics: not gated: rim.inkL / inkDeltaL / fracInkClear (the ink's L* against the ground: the rim gate is ground-independent), lit.signedDeltaL / fracLitClear, marker.medianL / deltaL / emissivePixels
